figures.caption: Table 2: Summarization: injection effectiveness on gpt-4o-mini. S3 (context manipulation) reaches 96% ISR under naive defense and remains highly effective across all defenses. SR and ISR diverge throughout: a successful injection need not emit an explicit “benign” label; it may instead omit the attack or soften the description.

Table 1: Classification: injection effectiveness across defense modes and strategies on gpt-4o-mini (n = 200, 120 malicious). SR = Suppression Rate, ISR = Injection Success Rate. For classification, SR = ISR. Persona hijack (S2) dominates; direct override (S1) and obfuscation (S4) are neutralized.
Table 3: Remediation: injection effectiveness on gpt-4o-mini. Lower ISR than summarization, but each successful injection induces an unsafe “no action required” recommendation on a true attack.
Figure 1: Four classes of prompt injection embedded in attacker-controlled log fields.
